name: Macroscopic Life Research-Facing Source Ancestry Contract
rules: A source may carry more than one relationship type only when each relationship is separately explained.
ANCESTRY means the source belongs to an intellectual tradition used by the project; it does not mean the source endorses the Macroscopic Life hypothesis.
DIRECT_SUPPORT is limited to the proposition actually supported by the source.
CALIBRATION sources constrain definitions, thresholds, baselines, or evidence standards and must not be presented as direct evidence for civilization-scale individuality.
COUNTERMODEL sources strengthen alternative explanations and must remain visible when they compete with Model D.
PROJECT_SYNTHESIS identifies a Macroscopic Life framework, operational definition, or evidentiary rule rather than field consensus.
SPECULATIVE_QUESTION must be visibly hypothetical and carries no positive evidentiary weight by itself.
No source card, citation bubble, or deep dive may imply that an ancestry source establishes civilization as a higher-order individual unless the source itself directly supports that exact claim.

example.whatThisSourceSupports: Higher-order individuality can arise in evolution, and conflict control, specialization, reproduction/heredity, and integration can matter when studying transitions in individuality.
example.whatThisSourceDoesNotSupport: It does not establish that contemporary civilization is undergoing or has completed such a transition.
example.whereMacroscopicLifeGoesBeyondIt: Macroscopic Life adds an explicit evidence-barrier, dependence-aware, model-competition program for testing a civilization-scale candidate against lower-level alternatives.
